entry.title: [NEWS] Ask HN: What's your current AI agentic setup?
[NEWS] OpenAI seems to be silently re-enabling model training on Codex chats
[NEW] a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view
entry.content:
Try: ~/.codex/config.toml → [features] multi_agent = true, hooks = true

Parallel subagents and lifecycle hooks, the same shape as Claude Code's.
